title: Probe Response / Raw Run Manifest v0
$comment: PROVISIONAL — AUDIT INFRASTRUCTURE ONLY. The raw run manifest a probe returns on stdout (DevSpec Section 30 and Section 42). It captures WHAT HAPPENED at the runtime, with paths to raw artifacts. A probe must NOT decide whether the lane passed an ALMS invariant, and must NOT rewrite a failed call into a fake success. This is the raw truth; it is NOT the normalized transcript.

model.$comment: The REQUESTED / configured model id (DevSpec Section 29, 'configured model id'). The provider-returned served model, when it differs, is preserved in the raw response artifact and, when the probe surfaces it, in provider_returned_model.

provider_returned_model.$comment: LEGACY optional companion (added P0.6C, retained for back-compat validation of prior artifacts). It asserts NO provenance and is NOT the authoritative cross-lane surface. As of P0.6D (N-05 resolved_offline) the authoritative model-identity contract lives on the RESULT record as observed_model_identity (requested_model / observed_returned_model / observed_returned_model_source / observed_returned_model_raw_ref / execution_mode / model_identity_match), derived by the harness normalizer from the raw response artifact — which already preserves the returned model as plain JSON. The probe never invents a returned model from the request; this field stays optional and unpopulated by the probes, kept only so older probe-response artifacts still validate.

retry_count_observed.$comment: null when the probe cannot measure framework-internal retries; NOT silently coerced to 0.

timeout_or_cancellation_action.$comment: Local cancellation != provider definitely stopped. This records the CLIENT-side action only.

capture_kind.$comment: Which native shape was captured; selects the harness normalizer branch.

execution_mode.$comment: offline_mock evidence is a mock simulation and must NEVER be labelled live evidence.
